svg.aria-label: Campaign prep sequence with five participants: you the game master, the Elephant (deep context), the campaign document (source of truth), fresh-context Goldfish reviewers, and the table. Phase 1 brainstorms the pitch with seven concurrent lenses and saves a prep brief. Phase 2 drafts the campaign one approved section at a time. Phase 3 reviews the arc with Continuity and Table critic, or a session with Substitute GM, Player's eye and Difficulty, then iterates on Blockers and Majors, with an optional second round. Phase 4 plays the session. Phase 5 debriefs, updates the document, and loops to the next session.
svg.title: EGM Campaign — Campaign Prep Protocol

g.text: ITERATE / Premise, arc, contingencies, session prep
OPTIONAL / Review again with new Goldfish (two rounds by default)
Ask about the table and the eight steps
Spawn reviewers on the document only
Choices the prep did not expect
Read the planned secrets, hooks, and scenes
Ask what happened, a few questions at a time
Update After play, secret status, open threads
